integrity: The infinite-family statement is supported by a self-contained homotopy proof. Exact finite mod-two boundary computations corroborate the formula but do not independently prove the universal or integral statements.
scientific_limitations: Only scale-one Johnson complexes and geometric fixed points of a single coordinate transposition are classified. More general permutation subgroups and the full equivariant homotopy type are not treated; unindexed equivalent literature cannot be excluded.
title: Transposition-fixed homotopy of Johnson-graph clique complexes
